notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility Update
notes.content:
Since GILTSTEADER's early development, playtesters have been providing feedback on how the game performed on the Steam Deck, which ultimately led to the addition of controller support and other features to help make the game ready for Steam Deck verification. Recently, I was finally able to test it out for myself, and the experience was incredible!

While we are still waiting on official Steam Deck verification, I thought it'd be worthwhile to walk through the criteria from [url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/steamdeck/compat]Steam's compatibility review process[/url] and let the community know how GILTSTEADER performed based on my own experience:

[h3][b]Input[/b][/h3]

[b]Controller support:[/b] The game has Xbox controller support which works natively with the Steam Deck's physical controls that match what is available on an Xbox controller. Everything worked and felt the same as using a controller.

[b]Controller glyphs:[/b] When using a controller, the glyphs in-game automatically change to controller glyphs.

[b]Text input: [/b] Not applicable as the game has no text input boxes.

[h3][b]Display[/b][/h3]

[b]Resolution support:[/b] The game detects the Steam Deck's native resolution and automatically runs at 1200x800. The game's UI automatically adjusts to various resolutions.

[b]Default configuration:[/b] The game's default configuration (such as graphics and post-FX) ran smoothly on the Steam Deck throughout my playthroughs.

[b]Text legibility: [/b] All UI text was legible, and the only instance of hard-to-read text was some of the turret pop-up menu when the camera was fully zoomed-out, which also occurs on PC screens because you are zoomed away from an in-world 3D object.

[h3][b]Seamlessness[/b][/h3]

[b]Compatibility warnings:[/b] No compatibility warnings were given, as the game runs natively on Windows.

[b]Launchers:[/b] The game does not have a launcher.


While we await official verification from Steam, I can confidently say that the experiences of myself and playtesters on the Steam Deck have been overwhelmingly positive. Go try it for yourself!

notes.title: Biomes & Bonus Attacks
notes.content:
[h3][b]Biomes[/b][/h3]
The hordes of rogue agricultural drones are spreading to other colonies, and you can now defend homesteads in three different biomes in Day Mode. These "biomes" are just different color-schemes that provide players with options beyond the desert region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/2f002e423f943396c8e045c88d16af484e14943b.png[/img]

[h3][b](Super) Bonus Attacks[/b][/h3]
Each tier 6 turret now has a small chance upon firing to trigger a [b]Super Bonus [/b]that will double their fire rate and range for a limited time. The 10% regular bonus attacks still exist and can trigger during these Super Bonus activations.

notes.title: Introducing Endless Mode
notes.content:
After defeating the final super drone on Wave 40, players now have two ways to end their game: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/fdbceae3119326d76106b5d359b0403bb2371eaa.png[/img]

If you choose to [i]Claim Victory[/i], you will end the game and the normal victory bonus will be added to your final score.

However, if you choose [i]Endless Mode[/i], instead of receiving the normal victory bonus, you will activate an "endless" march of bonus drones that get stronger each spawn. Your new victory bonus becomes the amount of bonus drones you defeat multiplied by 20.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/314f2f085be586c36a4a7ccf08106a46677be425.png[/img]

Additional notes:
[list]
[*] Both options will count as a victory.
[*] Upon choosing  [i]Endless Mode[/i], any spawned test drones will be destroyed, any planted vegals will be auto-harvested, and any remaining seeds and fishing bait will be removed from your inventory.
[*] Your Gameplay History will track bonus drones defeated per game, as well as your highest bonus drone score.
[*] Crowd Control viewers can't send players fishing bait or seeds, or summon test drones during Endless Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: GILTSTEADER + Crowd Control
notes.content:
For all the streamers out there, GILTSTEADER will feature[url=https://crowdcontrol.live/guides/giltsteader/][b] Crowd Control[/b][/url] support! This is a streamer tool that lets your viewers interact with the games you play on stream. Yes, it will be pure chaos.

When enabled, Crowd Control will let your viewers dictate your fortune with the following [url=https://crowdcontrol.live/game/giltsteader/?pack=Giltsteader]effects[/url]:
[list]
[*] Give and take various resources
[*] Increase or decrease vegal (crop) prices for an entire wave
[*] Harvest or kill growing vegals
[*] Throw away or sell the vegals in your inventory
[*] Summon test drones to give seeds (or take lives)[/list]
It is strongly advised to complete the tutorial without Crowd Control enabled... for your sanity's sake.

[url=https://x.com/CrowdControl/status/1816538245666083100]Here's some footage of streamers playing GILTSTEADER with Crowd Control.[/url]

notes.title: A Brief Guide to GILTSTEADER
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Giltsteading[/b][/u][/h3]
This is the art of farming and selling crops for [b]gilt[/b], which is planet Highseed's currency, and is used in the fabrication of turrets and upgrades.

Highseed's governing body mandates that all residents must achieve complete self-sufficiency, making giltsteading a crucial responsibility for every household.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/f5a11fd2ec4cbccbeec458fdf2feb84e0ec0cb52.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Farming Drones[/b][/u][/h3]
To enhance the ease of homesteading for the ordinary resident, farming drones have reached an advanced stage of development. Sadly, these drones have unexpectedly malfunctioned, and are now wreaking havoc by attacking local farms. It is imperative that you take action to safeguard your homestead from their destructive behavior. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/cde7abd3198881a31fd9a47609803fc7138d06ca.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Turrets[/b][/u][/h3]
To fight back, you will need to fabricate turrets. These autonomous defense devices automatically fire when an enemy drone is within range, and come in various [b]types [/b]and [b]tiers[/b].

There is one main quirk to note: [b]The type of a turret is randomly selected when it is fabricated or upgraded.[/b] In roguelike fashion, randomness plays a key role in GILTSTEADER, so you are forced to adapt and work with your circumstances.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/92332e157b55829a192a7c19181711d4ec8207f2.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Tier-Boosting[/b][/u][/h3]
When you have two matching turrets of the same type and tier, you can [b]tier-boost[/b] them. This process increases the tier of the selected turret and randomizes its type, and consumes a random matching turret.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/ae56c06c34681bf90d1b41d8e6a01a37cac0bd49.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Vegals[/b][/u][/h3]
Let's get back to farming, [b]as it is the most effective means to acquire gilt.[/b]

Any edible crop grown on planet Highseed is known as a [b]vegal[/b]. Your humble homestead grows three different types of vegals:[b] bloobs, redroots, and sprouts.[/b] 

They're all equally delicious and nutritious, and each one has a different price on the market. [b]These prices shift each wave[/b], allowing you to time your sales and maximize your profits.

However, to begin growing them, you must obtain [b]seeds[/b], which can be acquired through various means. Upon successfully defeating a wave of enemies, you'll be rewarded with two seeds. Additionally, you can acquire seeds by engaging in [b]fishing[/b], [b]completing quests[/b], and summoning and defeating[b] test drones.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/a867a028b804447a25fc95be8f42e60527d7aca2.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Fishing[/b][/u][/h3]
If you possess a keen eye, you'll discover the hidden fishing spots nestled along the river near your homestead. Simply interact with these fishing spots and let fate decide what treasures await you. To go fishing you'll need fishing bait, and you earn one bait per wave. 

You can earn seeds, gilt, and if you're really lucky you might even find an [b]upgrade credit[/b] while fishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/55fa31d641252a9e7a31651ee54a5c3108b12e4d.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Upgrades[/b][/u][/h3]
If you are unable to come across any upgrade credits during your fishing endeavors, there is no need to worry! You will be rewarded with one upgrade credit after every five waves. These valuable credits can then be utilized to acquire a range of enhancements for your homestead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/d320d9f7591dc033b6d233f3dd18df70d44ec68b.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Quests[/b][/u][/h3]
These missions primarily revolve around the turrets and vegals that are currently on your farm. For instance, upon planting 20 vegals simultaneously, you will fulfill that quest and receive a small number of seeds as a reward.

Some quests are harder to complete, such as having all tiers of a turret type fabricated at once, or having every type of a single turret tier simultaneously fabricated.

Completing multiple quests is a great way earn more seeds, plant more vegals, and stay ahead of the curve. The predicament posed by these quests is the potential need to delay upgrading specific towers, leaving you vulnerable to losing lives if your defenses are not strong enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/34ad6073294d38ee4a33a754810df10b666310f0.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Test Drones[/b][/u][/h3]
An alternative method to acquire seeds involves summoning test drones. These mechanical beings are unsuccessful prototypes of companion drones, and they have proven to be more suitable for target practice. However, if you fail to defeat the drone before it reaches the conclusion of your homestead maze, it will take some of your lives.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/5582af85612cd6d2dba4eb4c9b9715d081694438.png[/img]



[h3][u][b]Super Drones[/b][/u][/h3]
On every tenth wave, you will encounter a super drone. These drones possess significantly more health compared to the regular farming drones, and they will genuinely challenge your defensive capabilities. Failing to defeat the final super drone on the last wave will result in the end of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913812/cb40580c39f88b8f8f4b2a683f5e4da19813b272.png[/img]



While there's much more to discover and master within GILTSTEADER, you're now familiar with the basics and ready to do your part in stopping the drones from destroying planet Highseed.
